name: MarsCon
blurb: A fan-run, family-friendly Twin Cities convention covering sci-fi, fantasy, anime, art, cosplay, gaming and music every spring.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'ABOUT US MarsCon 2027: Sci-Fi? What a Joke! March 5-7 2027'; hotel page: 'Convention Location Hilton Minneapolis-St. Paul Airport 3800 American Blvd. E. Bloomington, Minnesota 55425', reservation link dated arrivalDate=2027-03-04&departureDate=2027-03-07

notes: The homepage itself says 'Our 2027 guests will be announced soon' (linking to a media-GoH page). The /guests/ page does show cards headed '2027 Guests of Honor' (David Gerrold) and '2027 Featured Guests' (Adrian Lee, Heather Morris), but a web search found Adrian Lee and Heather Morris described as guests for MarsCon 2026's 'Sci-Fi of Yesteryear' theme, and the site's own /updates/ page (last edited '2/15/26') is still talking about load-in volunteers for the prior cycle under the same 2027-branded header/nav. Since several pages on this site clearly carry over unrefreshed prior-year content under the new year's banner, and the homepage's own current messaging says 2027 guests aren't announced yet, guests is recorded as none-yet rather than trusting the possibly-stale guests page. A 'Past Notable Presenters' card for C. M. Alongi on that same page is explicitly labelled as a past presenter, not a current guest, and was excluded either way.
